messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE triggered — High latency spike in dedicated pool 'prod-dedicated-west'. Alerts: p95 token latency > 800ms, queue depth high. Investigating.
mike-oncall: on it. where's the traffic coming from? any recent deploys to that pool?
lee-sre: no deploys in last 2hrs. seeing a sudden surge from a few heavy tenants. autoscaler didn't add nodes — hit pool cap. logs show enqueue backlog around 00:12UTC.
alex-platform: I can toggle burst capacity temporarily. prepping command now.
alex-platform: running:
```
rbxctl pools update prod-dedicated-west --burst-capacity 1.5 --reason "surge 2026-03-16"
```
alex-platform: API returned 200, burst capacity increased to 150% for pool prod-dedicated-west. :white_check_mark:
mike-oncall: good. I'm going to apply per-tenant qps limits to heavy tenants to protect overall latency.
mike-oncall: applying limit to tenant-42 and tenant-99:
```
redwood-admin quotas set --tenant tenant-42 --qps 12 --scope prod-dedicated-west
redwood-admin quotas set --tenant tenant-99 --qps 8  --scope prod-dedicated-west
```
mike-oncall: applied. routing shows immediate drop in tail latencies for requests not from those tenants.
jamie-cs: flagged tenant-42 & tenant-99 in support. sending customer note: "We detected increased traffic affecting your latency; we’ve applied temporary rate limits while we stabilize. We’ll follow up shortly." will cc account execs.
lee-sre: also disabling non-critical background scoring to reduce token work:
```
feature-toggle set reranker-v2 false --scope prod-dedicated-west --expires 30m
```
lee-sre: toggle successful. removed ~30% of background token work on pool.
alex-platform: autoscaler cap is the root cause — opening quick fix to raise max nodes for the pool and adjust scaling windows.
mike-oncall: p95 down to ~120ms from 900ms, overall QPS steady. monitoring for 15m.
sara-ops: handoff — I'm taking over monitoring from @mike-oncall for the next shift. mike, if anything changes ping me.
mike-oncall: thanks, Sara. leaving notes in Incident channel and toggles are documented in the incident ticket.
inc-bot: Incident status set to mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ID INC-20260316-005. Auto-updates enabled.
lee-sre: follow-up action items: 1) increase autoscaler sensitivity (lower scale-up threshold), 2) add burst toggle runbook + RBAC checks, 3) post-mortem with CS/Platform.
jamie-cs: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and cleanup messaging.
sara-ops: monitoring looks stable for now. leaving burst enabled for another 30m then will roll it down if metrics stay healthy. will create a post-incident ticket with action owners.
mike-oncall: :thumbsup: great job everyone. closing pager for now.
